note: Wave status the deck reads. Written by the orchestrator when an agent is launched and when it reports. The deck shows the `asOf` stamp rather than implying live polling — a published page cannot see this session, and pretending otherwise is the same failure as a screen rendering a total it did not compute.
waveNote: The critical path. Ten product agents idle until these contracts are stable.

agents.name: Integration & Release
agents.scope: CI pipeline, shared-file arbitration, re-verifying each agent's Definition of Done before anything merges
blocks: every merge to main — no agent merges its own branch
agents.notes: Verifying rather than trusting has caught: a mis-parse in my own generator, a wrongly-framed SOD finding, an agent that produced 68 files and no report, and a claim I made twice that agent 06 was running when it had never been launched — this file said 'queued' the whole time.

agents.name: Backend & Data

blocks: every capability's Definition of Done — real data, persistence and audit are clauses in it
agents.notes: Landed as dcb4d54 — but the agent never reported. Its work was on disk when it went away, so nothing arrived with a claim attached and everything was verified from scratch: 146 server tests against a real PostgreSQL 16 started in this container, plus a direct RLS probe showing a tenant cannot read, update, delete or forge another tenant's rows, and that a missing context fails closed.

Also carries four findings: F-002 (fixed in the client, must match server-side), F-004 (sodViolation exists and is tested but has no caller — wire it over the audit log), F-005 (two dead field rules), F-006 (roleMeta fails open, and a role is about to arrive from a JWT claim, which is when that stops being unreachable).
